basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services, event-driven microservices, and GitOps-driven automation systems. Passionate about leveraging robust testing, efficient developer toolchains, and clean code to build highly reliable and impactful global financial platforms.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based event-driven microservices processing 10M+ daily events, ensuring high availability and reliability for critical global operations.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, enhancing system stability and efficiency for global service delivery.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing local code styling and rigorous testing standards crucial for maintaining secure and robust production systems.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, significantly accelerating feature delivery and improving developer productivity.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, enabling secure and reliable data exchange for critical platform functionalities.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors for external developer platforms, expanding service capabilities and enhancing user experience.
Implemented a suite of unit and integration tests raising coverage from 60% to 92%, significantly improving code quality and system integrity.
